verses.gurmukhi: ਸਉਦਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਹੈ ਸਾਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: saudhaa ikat haT hai saahu satigur pooraa|

en.bdb: The perfect true Guru keeps the actual merchandise (of the name of the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਲੈ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਕਣੈ ਵਚਨੈ ਦਾ ਸੂਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: aaugun lai gun vikanai vachanai dhaa sooraa|

en.bdb: He is that brave person who accepts the evils and upkeep’s his reputation of being giver of virtues.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਿੰਮਲੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਸੋਵਰਨੁ ਮਨੂਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: safal karai si(n)mal birakh sovaran manooraa|

en.bdb: He can grow juicy fruits on silk-cotton trees and can produce gold from the iron ash.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਸਿ ਸੁਵਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਉ ਹੰਸੁ ਨ ਊਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: vaas suvaas nivaas kar kaau ha(n)s na uooraa|

en.bdb: He infuses fragrance in the bamboo i.e. he makes egotists feel humble and makes crows no less than swans who are capable of distinguishing water from milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘੁਘੂ ਸੁਝੁ ਸੁਝਾਇਦਾ ਸੰਖ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੂਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: ghughoo sujh sujhaidhaa sa(n)kh motee chooraa|

en.bdb: He transforms owls into knowledgeable ones and dust into conches and pearls.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਜੂਰਾ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit_en: vedh katebahu baaharaa gur sabadh hajooraa ||21||

en.bdb: Such a Guru who is beyond the description of the Vedas and Katebas (the semitic scriptures becomes manifest by the grace of Word, the brahmn)
